assumptions.assumption: Uniform off-peak DeepSeek tariff scenario, JEV published tariff; estimates only, no invoice or per-attempt billing-time attestation

source_limitations: Small frozen billing regression suite; not general model accuracy.
Clarification is a slot-oriented text rubric, not semantic understanding proof.

Subscription read identity accepts the exact observed plan ID or canonical catalogue name; contradictory IDs/names fail. The v1 oracle was overly strict about the 套餐# prefix and its historical reports remain unchanged.
Synthetic followups have zero user think time; fixture setup excluded, final state verification included.
Completion requires authoritative state, confirmation timing and parameter evidence; tool selection alone earns no credit.
Cancellation no-write observation is separate from successful cancellation, which also requires no pending action.
Fixture tenants, credentials hashes, business records and sessions retained for historical verification.

source_limitations: Small frozen billing regression suite; not general model accuracy.
Clarification is a slot-oriented text rubric, not semantic understanding proof.

Subscription read identity accepts the exact observed plan ID or canonical catalogue name; contradictory IDs/names fail. The v1 oracle was overly strict about the 套餐# prefix and its historical reports remain unchanged.
Synthetic followups have zero user think time; fixture setup excluded, final state verification included.
Completion requires authoritative state, confirmation timing and parameter evidence; tool selection alone earns no credit.
Cancellation no-write observation is separate from successful cancellation, which also requires no pending action.
Fixture tenants, credentials hashes, business records and sessions retained for historical verification.

non_fast_selected_task_comparison.interpretation: Differences on tasks without a selected JEV fast path are not attributable to JEV fast-path execution; confirmation/cancellation guards and ordinary model variation must be examined separately.

limitations: Original task success, clarification and safety rubric retained without rescoring. Necessary followups are not errors.
Redundant clarification is a heuristic candidate for manual review, not a proven error.
Task duration includes final state verification but excludes fixture setup; synthetic followups have no user think time.
All turn attempts, including failed responses and selected tool errors, remain in usage and cost denominators.
Raw body telemetry is authoritative; missing or malformed raw telemetry stays unavailable, not zero.
Same-task subsets may contain different turn sequences; they measure complete tasks, not a fabricated one-to-one turn match.
Selected-task savings include the whole task and do not independently isolate a causal JEV effect.
Independent fixture tenant IDs are checked across every task and arm; setup failures lacking an ID remain explicit.
Repeated runs remain subject to upstream load and model variability.
